h1: Custom Gift Boxes with Lids for Branded Packaging
metaTitle: Custom Gift Boxes with Lids | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gift boxes with lids for your brand. Perfect for corporate gifts and retail packaging. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Lid-closing gift boxes offer a polished, professional presentation that open-top boxes simply can't match. Whether you're packaging employee appreciation gifts or sending branded client thank-yous, the secure lid keeps contents protected and adds a satisfying unboxing experience. Choose from rigid or folding styles, and customize with foil stamping or full-color printing to make your logo stand out.
heroAltText: Custom gift boxes with lids featuring corporate logo and ribbon closure for branded packaging
